envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: first-share piece 3 calls for install to offer practices; the operator's note had settled closure, declaration by the corpus and plumbing as a dependency
envelope.cause: note 'install offers practices, not the whole corpus'

payload.gloss: a way of working cratylus offers as one installable choice: the agents, skills and hooks that carry it, installed together. A practice is closed under skill composition and agent dispatch, so every agent it installs finds every skill it composes and every agent it dispatches; a set that is not closed ships a broken agent. Which practices exist is meaning, so the corpus declares them and install only offers them. Plumbing that other parts need, such as the event tap, is installed as a dependency and never offered on its own. Why: a consumer adopts a way of working, not a file list, and installing the whole corpus by default puts agents and skills on a host that no one there will use.
